summary.intent: Coordinate multiple subagents improving a code-search CLI (michi): add --offset paging, diagnose and improve ranking quality, plus lean Rust rows and perf work, while the user reviews and merges PRs.
summary.outcome: PR #112 (--offset paging) was pushed and marked ready with CI pending; a ranking diagnosis was completed recommending a prefix-token name match plus Impl prior 0.9 (+2 answerable, +3 rank-1, no losses). Follow-up agents were launched for the prefix/Impl PR, a hint-total correctness check on #112, and a container-vs-member experiment.

repo: Ranking benchmark corpus is 222 rows (59 identifiers, 150 questions+members); 'answerable' means the expected declaration is in the top 3 rows; baseline is 204/222 and 105/150 at rank 1.

The #108 name boost matches name tokens to query terms; the recommended change lets a token of at least 3 chars match a term that starts with it (ext matches extension) at full weight with exact bonus.
Impl node prior lowered from 1.1 to 0.9 helps only 2 of 10 container-vs-member misses.

Rejected ranking levers: plain bidirectional prefix (loses blind #18 parseISO), block-length caps and BM25 b changes (lose 1-3 answerable), Variable/Struct/Interface node priors (lose blind rows and rank-1s).
Analyzer gap: four fd identifiers declared via `mod x;` in main.rs have no block; five zod identifiers are same-name twins.
Misses not fixable by ranking: legitimate twins, query ambiguity, example/test paths, acronym or compound names (ws, Sse).

--offset semantics: relevance cut is measured against the global top score (consistent across pages); row cap and --max-tokens bound the returned page; offset past the end prints a count and exits 0; non-numeric exits 2.
Budget and SearchResponse gain a public offset field, a library API change noted in a minor changeset.
Project checks are run via just: lint, test, changesets, rg-compare, bench.
Decision log is docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md (§47 added for offset).

friction: Network was blocked, so the ranking diagnosis ran against a local ref and repos copied from existing checkouts rather than fetched.
CI had not yet run on #112 when reported.
Possible over-promise in the --offset hint: its total may count rows hidden by the relevance cut.
open_items: Hint-total check on #112: if the total counts cut-hidden rows, fix the hint (next: --offset N while rows survive the cut, then --min-score 0 with the hidden count) and add an exact-value paging-walk test.
Prefix-token name match plus Impl 0.9 PR (trail 361) in progress.
Lean Rust rows (trail 363) and perf pass (trail 362) still running.
User to review and merge #109, #111 (after changelog skim) and #112 once CI finishes.
Analyzer gap for `mod x;` identifiers in fd and twin handling for zod remain unaddressed.
